turns.content: Summarize the outage. Keep each answer under 30 words.

The outage began when a routine deploy shipped a misconfigured connection pool, which slowly exhausted database sockets across every region, causing cascading timeouts, elevated error rates, retries that amplified load, and eventually a full loss of read and write availability for roughly forty minutes until the deploy was rolled back and pools were reset.
